title: 1901 Prairie's porch gets carved capitals and scrolled stone cheeks
items: The four columns of the Ream house's porch now have carved capitals, a bell of leaves under the abacus, as the 1898 photograph shows them.

The stoop's cheeks are now solid stone walls that run straight down the steps from the porch and end in a stone roll at the walk, as both photographs draw them, where before they were plain straight slabs.
